title: Does Emergent Misalignment Persist After RLHF Fine-Tuning on Top?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Critical question for production safety: if RLHF removes misalignment, deployment pipelines already contain the fix. If misalignment survives RLHF, the threat to deployed models is far more severe. Direct implications for every model provider's pipeline.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires both SFT and DPO training stages. TRL library simplifies DPO but beginners need to understand preference data formats and DPO hyperparameters. Two-stage training pipeline is more complex than single-stage experiments.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two-stage pipeline (SFT then DPO) with evaluation at both stages. Plus optional activation analysis. Clear deliverable (before/after comparison) but the two-stage training is time-intensive for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
